parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries an empty `members` array and all structural evidence fields (`differing_slots`, `jaccard`, `shared_ancestor`, `shared_field_count`) are null. Without any grounded field-list, method-list, or similarity metric, there is no verifiable evidence that `HSBColor` in `Shared/ColorPalette/Sources/ColorPalette/HSBColor.swift` and `AccentColor.CodingKeys` in `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Core/ThemeColors.swift` share meaningful structure beyond a superficial shape signal. `CodingKeys` is a compiler-synthesised nested enum whose shape coincidentally mirrors other small enums across the codebase; this is a well-known source of false positives in shape-based clustering. Recommending a refactor without concrete evidence would risk conflating unrelated domain concepts (HSB colour representation vs. JSON coding keys for an accent-colour type).
